# Event Creation

## Problem

Activities are ongoing, but there's no way to create and manage one-time or special events like competitions, performances, or tournaments.

## Recommended Solution

Add an event creation system with detailed information:

- Event name, date, and time
- Event description and location
- Assigned judges or supervisors
- Prize information (if applicable)
- Associated committee or club
- Maximum participants and registration list
- Event status (upcoming, ongoing, completed)

## Context

This will allow admins to manage special events separately from regular activities. Events should have their own endpoint in the API and be displayed differently in the UI to distinguish them from recurring activities.
